title: Here’s How to Watch ‘The Traitors: New Blood’ Live Online for Free
summary: The reality competition returns with a two-episode premiere on NBC, followed by new episodes streaming on Peacock the next day.
contentText:

After four seasons of celebrity contestants, The Traitors is bringing a new group of players to the castle. The Traitors: New Blood premieres Thursday (Sept. 17) on NBC and Peacock , with Alan Cumming returning as host. The new installment features 22 everyday Americans competing at Ardross Castle in Scotland for a prize of up to $250,000.

The all-civilian cast marks a major change for the reality competition, which has previously featured reality stars and other recognizable personalities. The new contestants were selected from more than 80,000 applicants and include an astrophysicist, barrel racer, funeral director, ironworker, pilot, teacher and MLB analyst.

The Traitors are once again hidden among the Faithfuls, with the contestants tasked with figuring out who they can trust while competing in missions to build the prize fund. The Faithfuls must banish all of the Traitors to win; if a Traitor survives until the end, the Traitors take the prize.

livestream 'Traitors: New Blood' free with directv 5-day trial

Here’s when and where to watch The Traitors: New Blood online.

When Does The Traitors: New Blood Premiere?

The Traitors: New Blood premieres live on Thursday, Sept. 17, at 8 p.m. ET/PT on NBC with two back-to-back episodes. Viewers can watch the live premiere, without traditional network television, through DirecTV or Fubo , both offering five-day free trials, as well as Sling and Hulu + Live TV .

The show will return with another two-episode night Thursday, Sept. 24, at 8 p.m. ET/PT. Beginning Oct. 8, the series will air one new episode each Thursday at 8 p.m. ET/PT.

How to Stream The Traitors: New Blood Online

For those who have cut the cord, NBC is still easy to stream live. DirecTV , Fubo , Sling and Hulu + Live TV all carry the network, with five-day free trials offered by DirecTV and Fubo.

That means the Sept. 17 premiere episodes will arrive on Peacock Friday, Sept. 18, while the Sept. 24 episodes will stream Friday, Sept. 25. Subsequent episodes will follow the same next-day streaming schedule.

Peacock

Get Peacock

A Peacock Premium subscription costs $12.99 per month or $129.99 annually, while Premium Plus runs $19.99 per month or $199.99 annually with additional ad-free viewing and other perks. Students can get a discounted rate of $6.99 per month for their first year before the plan renews at the then-current price.

While Peacock doesn’t currently offer a standard free trial, savvy viewers can still access the streamer through options including DirecTV , Prime Video and Instacart+ , each with its own trial or promotional offer.

Two Free Months of Peacock With DirecTV

DirecTV is offering two free months of Peacock Premium with any Signature package. To claim the deal, choose a Signature package and select “Movies Extra Pack + Peacock Premium” when prompted to add extras. The offer includes both for two months at no additional cost.

Who Is in the The Traitors: New Blood Cast?

The 22 contestants competing in The Traitors: New Blood are Abbey Benjamin, Abby Lee, Arisa Thomas, Ben McDonnell, Clyde Moser, Jay Vinnedge, Joe Vanella, Katie Fites, Kim Daily, Kriste Lewis, Logan Smith, Madeline Kostopulos, Mark Zgoda, Michael Foote, Morgan Cook, Niyyah Bilal Hayes, Shane Beatty, Sherry Kuehl, Tomica Adams, Victor Vollbrechthausen, Wyatt Gillespie and Xavier Scruggs.

Their jobs range from nurse and astrophysicist to attorney, content creator, pilot and business executive. They will compete under Cumming’s watch as the Faithfuls attempt to identify the hidden Traitors before they are eliminated from the game.

What Is The Traitors: New Blood About?

Set at Ardross Castle in the Scottish Highlands, the competition puts the 22 players through missions that help build a prize fund worth up to $250,000. Each night, the secret Traitors can “murder” a Faithful, while the group gathers to banish a player they suspect is working against them.

The civilian version keeps the basic structure of The Traitors while giving the game an entirely new cast of players with no prior reality TV experience.
